stories.title: District of Squamish asks residents to limit indoor water use after wet B.C. weather
stories.summary: The rain and wind warnings have been dropped across British Columbia's coast, but flooding is still a risk as other communities manage the aftermath.

stories.title: Trina Hunt’s family alleges husband killed her, seeks return of assets in B.C. lawsuit
stories.summary: A new civil claim alleges Iain Hunt killed his wife and should be barred from benefiting financially from her death. The allegations have not been proven in court.

stories.title: Woman posts video saying she was harassed by youths on Vancouver bus
stories.summary: She says in her video that the group called her names, made rude gestures and one of them blew vape smoke in her face, all unprovoked.

stories.title: Summerland woman’s stolen family coin collection rebuilt by content creator
stories.summary: When Marcia Kozak evacuated Summerland during the Bald range wildfire, she took some of the most important things she could with her, her cat and her late mother’s coin collection.

stories.title: Man who shot B.C. doctor in the face sentenced to seven years in prison
stories.summary: Justin Littlewolfe was sentenced to seven years in prison and with enhanced credit for time spent in custody since his arrest, he has just over three years left to serve.

stories.title: Life sentence handed to Vancouver man guilty of first-degree murder twice
stories.summary: "I don't think we'll ever feel closure because a life was taken from this earth unjustly, cruelly," Zenan Cepeda Silva's granddaughter, Elba Gonzales, said.

stories.title: B.C. Lions want to own or operate home stadium
stories.summary: B.C. Lions owner Amar Doman says the CFL team is interested in owning or operating BC Place, its home stadium in Vancouver.

stories.title: NDP caucus to take oath in Victoria while Eby to be sworn in separately
stories.summary: New Democrats will be sworn into office in the British Columbia legislature Thursday but former premier David Eby won't be among them.

stories.title: Evacuation orders, alerts issued as flood risks mount on Vancouver Island
stories.summary: Nanaimo has issued an evacuation order south of the city for some properties along the Nanaimo River in the community of Cedar, with residents told to leave immediately.

stories.title: Shooting at the auto shop: how Canada is tackling India’s extortion gangs
stories.summary: Documents obtained by Global News give a rare inside look at an investigation into an extortion scheme.
